[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] owned a [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] '''X-34 landspeeder''' during his youth on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It had a top speed of two hundred and fifty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] and the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] kept the vehicle hoving a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] off the ground at all times.<ref name="CCG-Luke" /> Skywalker used the X-34 to search for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] who escaped from the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]], and later to transport himself, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the two droids to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Skywalker sold the landspeeder to [[Spaceport Speeders/Legends|Spaceport Speeders]] for two thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="CCG-Spaceport">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Spaceport Speeders}}</ref> to help pay for passage to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="ANH" />
